branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A white cheese kept in brine, in the feta style, made by Dairy Khoury in Lebanon. The maker describes it as soft, wet and crumbly, with a slightly grainy texture and a fresh, lemony taste.

sources.text: The product description and its brine, from this page.
